sections.markdown:
## E2 — Competitive teardown: turn signals, turning lanes, U-turns, intersections and roundabouts
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (OR-TURN-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: competitors may teach a generic national rule for turns on red; the Oregon road-type distinction and the city versus rural U-turn distances could be a beat point once verified.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: Competitive teardown of Oregon knowledge-test prep products for the turn signals, turning lanes, U-turns, intersections and roundabouts topic is unresearched.
